title: Four Key Focuses.
instruction: Select both Blueprint PDFs in Chat. Try either prompt below.
prompt_en: Summarise the Blueprint’s Four Key Focuses and Ten Strategies for secondary-school teachers. Use a four-column table: Key focus; Strategy; Suggested teacher action; Citation. Include all ten strategies, grouped by focus, one row per strategy. Keep cells brief and distinguish suggestions from official requirements. Write in English.
prompt_zh: 請為中學教師整理《藍圖》的「四大重點•十大策略」。用四欄表格：發展重點、推行策略、建議教師行動、出處。按重點分組，每項策略一行，共十行。內容簡潔，分清建議與官方要求。請以繁體中文回答。
